text: On December 13, 2016 City Council directed staff to report back by the second quarter of 2018 with a status update on the George Street Revitalization (GSR) Project. Council also authorized the development of the Project Specific Output Specifications (PSOS) and the continuation of due diligence to ensure that the Project is ready for procurement. Project funding was approved through the 2018-2027 Capital Budget and Plan. Due diligence is proceeding well and negotiations are underway with Ontario Infrastructure and Lands Corporation, known as Infrastructure Ontario (IO). Staff now seek authority to initiate the Alternative Financing and Procurement (AFP) approach using a Design-Build-Finance (DBF) model as previously approved by Council.
